tex_content.html:
Let $(M,g(t))$, $t_0\le t\le t_1$, be a Ricci flow. Every ramp in $M\times S^1_\lambda $ has a curve-shrinking flow on all of $[t_0,t_1]$, and all its slices are ramps.
Proof

↗ claim:curve-shrinking-short-time-existence ↗ claim:curve-shrinking-curvature-inequality ↗ claim:ramp-function-evolution ↗ cor:ramp-preserved-under-flow \sketch Source: morgan-tian-correction For $h=(k^2+\epsilon ^2)^{1/2}$, combine the inequalities for $h$ and $u$ to obtain

\[ \partial _t(h/u)\le (h/u)''+2(u'/u)(h/u)'+C'(h+1)/u. \]

The maximum principle bounds $h/u$ exponentially. Since $u$ stays uniformly positive on finite intervals, $k$ remains bounded, so the short-time continuation criterion extends the flow to $t_1$.

□
